scenes.say: Why is the Qatar night race one of the toughest of the season?
Lusail was built for motorbikes. Fast corners come one after another, and there are hardly any slow ones.
The car is cornering almost all the time, the tyres are on the limit, and even at night it's hot and humid.
In twenty twenty-three each set of tyres was capped at eighteen laps. Every team had to stop at least three times.
So in Qatar raw speed isn't enough. The race goes to whoever looks after the tyres.
Follow every driver's tyre age and pit stops live on LapRadar.

title: Qatar: the night race that eats tyres
